Block Applies for National Trust Bank Charter to Offer Bitcoin and Stablecoin Custody

Block has applied to the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to establish Builders Bank & Trust, N.A., an uninsured national trust bank. If approved, the bank would provide custody and related fiduciary services for assets including bitcoin and stablecoins under OCC supervision. It would not take deposits or make loans. Block Digital Asset Strategy Lead Lee Woolley is expected to serve as president and CEO of Builders Bank. — link

Robinhood Chain Generates 17,171 ETH ($42.58M) in Revenue in 70 Days

According to Arkham data, Robinhood Chain has generated approximately 17,171 ETH (about $42.58 million) in cumulative revenue since launching 70 days ago, averaging roughly $608,000 per day. About 90% of the revenue went to Robinhood Chain itself, equivalent to approximately 15,454 ETH (about $38.32 million), while the remaining 10%, or approximately 1,716 ETH (about $4.26 million), went to its technology provider Arbitrum. — link

Tether Freezes About $39.3M USDT Across 10 TRON Addresses Linked to Xinbi Guarantee

MistTrack said the action follows earlier freezes involving Huione-linked funds and may represent another crackdown on illicit Telegram-based escrow platforms. — link
